name: 李凤，Feng Li
faculty_intro: 李凤，北京化工大学教授、博士生导师，国家优秀青年科学基金获得者。本科毕业于兰州大学化学化工学院，博士毕业于中国科学院国家纳米科学中心，之后在清华大学化学系从事博士后阶段的研究。2018年入职天津大学化工学院，2022年调入北京化工大学化学学院担任化学+生物工程双学位专业负责人。研究成果在Chem. Soc. Rev.、Nature Commun.、J. Am. Chem. Soc.、Angew. Chem.、Adv. Mater.、Nano Lett.、Nano Today、Acc. Mater. Res.等杂志发表论文70余篇。申请专利13项，主持国家自然科学基金等基金项目7项。担任北京市药学会生物与基因药学专委会和核酸药物专委会委员、Chinese Chemical Letters编委、Advanced Clinical Engineering青年编委等。
faculty_intro_en: Feng Li is a professor and doctoral supervisor at Beijing University of Chemical Technology and a recipient of the National Science Fund for Excellent Young Scholars. She received her bachelor's degree from the College of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering at Lanzhou University and her Ph.D. from the National Center for Nanoscience and Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, followed by postdoctoral research in the Department of Chemistry at Tsinghua University. She joined the School of Chemical Engineering and Technology at Tianjin University in 2018 and moved to the College of Chemistry at Beijing University of Chemical Technology in 2022, where she serves as the director of the Chemistry and Bioengineering dual-degree program. She has published more than 70 papers in journals including Chem. Soc. Rev., Nature Commun., J. Am. Chem. Soc., Angew. Chem., Adv. Mater., Nano Lett., Nano Today, and Acc. Mater. Res. She has filed 13 patent applications and led seven research projects, including projects funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China. She serves on the Biopharmaceutical and Gene Pharmacy Committee and the Nucleic Acid Drug Committee of the Beijing Pharmaceutical Association, as an editorial board member of Chinese Chemical Letters, and as a young editorial board member of Advanced Clinical Engineering.

name: 董宇航，Yuhang Dong
faculty_intro: 董宇航，博士，北京化工大学化学学院讲师。分别于2017年和2022年在天津大学获学士学位和博士学位，2022年以博士后进入北京化工大学化学学院工作。研究方向为核酸化学、核酸纳米药物创制，以及新型药物递送系统的构建和生物医学研究。近年来，以通讯/第一作者在J. Am. Chem. Soc.、Angew. Chem. Int. Ed.、Chem. Rev.、Chem. Soc. Rev.、Nano Today、Adv. Funct. Mater.等期刊发表论文20余篇，申请发明专利11项，主持国家级、省部级等基金项目5项。现任Advanced Clinical Engineering、Chinese Chemical Letters期刊的青年编委。主讲《分析化学》、《核酸化学与材料》等课程。
faculty_intro_en: Yuhang Dong, Ph.D., is a lecturer in the College of Chemistry at Beijing University of Chemical Technology. He received his bachelor's and doctoral degrees from Tianjin University in 2017 and 2022, respectively, and joined the College of Chemistry at Beijing University of Chemical Technology as a postdoctoral researcher in 2022. His research focuses on nucleic acid chemistry, the development of nucleic acid nanomedicines, and the construction and biomedical investigation of novel drug delivery systems. In recent years, he has published more than 20 papers as a corresponding or first author in journals including J. Am. Chem. Soc., Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., Chem. Rev., Chem. Soc. Rev., Nano Today, and Adv. Funct. Mater. He has filed 11 invention patent applications and led five national, provincial, and ministerial research projects. He currently serves as a young editorial board member for Advanced Clinical Engineering and Chinese Chemical Letters. He teaches Analytical Chemistry and Nucleic Acid Chemistry and Materials.
